title: PublicRecordReading
description: What a company has published outside its own website, read from the authorities that hold it (SEC EDGAR, the GLEIF LEI registry, DNS, a Certificate Transparency monitor, the OFAC list, and since trooth 0.12.0 SAM.gov, the USPTO, four state registries, the FTC and RDAP), beside what its own site states, and the evidence tying each identifier to the domain. Served at https://api.trooth.co/scan/public-record/<domain>. Every fact carries the URL to read it again. Since trooth 0.11.0 each reading also carries `signed`: a statement naming the SHA-256 of the reading's RFC 8785 bytes (everything except `signed`), signed with Trooth's statement key and logged. Nothing in it grades, rates or ranks a company. docs/EVIDENCE.md in trooth-cli is the normative text.

read_at.description: When Trooth read the sources. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

site.description: What the company's own pages say about which legal entity it is.

bindings.description: Each identifier found and the evidence for and against tying it to the domain.

sec.description: The SEC filer's record, or null when no filer was identified.

lei.description: The LEI record, or null when none was identified.

dns.description: Mail-authentication records beyond SPF and DMARC, and DNSSEC.

entity.description: The legal entity the domain is tied to, when a binding is corroborated; null otherwise. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

certificates.description: Unexpired certificates for the exact domain name in Certificate Transparency logs, as a CT monitor returned them; null when it did not answer. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

security_txt.description: The site's /.well-known/security.txt (RFC 9116), or null when there is none or the site opted out of being read. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

sanctions.description: Entries on the OFAC sanctions list with exactly the legal names above. A name match is not an identification. Null when the list could not be read or no name was found. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

sources.description: Every response read for this reading, with the SHA-256 of the bytes read; Trooth keeps the bytes under that hash so a disputed fact can be replayed. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

not_read.description: Each source that was not read, or did not answer, and why. A source not read is never guessed at.

note.description: What the reading is and is not, as a paragraph.

sam.description: SAM.gov registrations and exclusions under the legal name, or null when SAM.gov was not read (not_read says why). A name match is not an identification. Added in trooth 0.12.0.

patents.description: Patent applications whose first applicant is the legal name, from the USPTO Open Data Portal, or null when it was not read. Added in trooth 0.12.0.

registries.description: Exact-name entries in the state business registries that publish open data (New York, Colorado, Connecticut, Oregon). A name match is not an identification. Added in trooth 0.12.0.

merger_review.description: Hart-Scott-Rodino early termination notices the FTC published naming the legal name as a party, or null when they were not read. Added in trooth 0.12.0.

domain_registration.description: The domain's registration, from RDAP, or null when no RDAP service answered. Added in trooth 0.12.0.

changes.description: What the sources in this reading record as having changed (renames, acquisitions and dispositions, changes in control, previous legal names, parents, merger review, domain registration), newest first. Added in trooth 0.12.0.

subjects.description: Every subject this reading names, each with why: the domain, the entity, filer and LEI ids, jurisdictions, state registry entries, SAM.gov UEIs, and the code repositories, APIs and MCP servers the home page links to (docs/IDS.md). Added in trooth 0.12.0.

evidence_classes.description: Each class of evidence in this reading with its stale-after rule, when it was observed and what it does not establish (docs/EVIDENCE.md section 10). Optional; added in trooth 0.13.0.

continuity.description: What changed since the previous cached reading of the same domain (docs/EVIDENCE.md section 10). Optional; added in trooth 0.13.0.

proofs.description: Each proof that binds two subjects, with its method and status (docs/EVIDENCE.md section 11): the domain to the company record (dns_txt, domain_email_code or identity_provider_sign_in, from Trooth's record of the claim or the challenge TXT), the domain to the company's own key (domain_signed_declaration, and dns_txt when the key pin matches), the domain to a code repository (repository_control). Optional; added in trooth 0.14.0.

declaration.description: The domain-signed declaration read at https://<domain>/.well-known/trooth.json (docs/DECLARATION.md), or null when it was not looked for. Only what checked is carried into subjects. Optional; added in trooth 0.14.0.

signed.description: The statement that names this reading, and its log receipt. Not part of the bytes it names. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

Sam.title: SamReading
Sam.description: SAM.gov, read under one legal name with Trooth's key (the key is never in the record). Cached for 30 days per name, so read_at can be earlier than the reading's.

read_at.description: When SAM.gov was read. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

registrations.description: Entity registrations with exactly that legal name, at most 10.

exclusions.description: Exclusion records with exactly that name, at most 20. A name match is not an identification.

cage.description: The CAGE code on the record.

classification.description: Firm, Individual, Vessel or Special Entity Designation.

Patents.title: PatentReading
Patents.description: Patent applications from the USPTO Open Data Portal. Cached for 7 days per name.

read_at.description: When it was read. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

applications.description: How many applications the search counted.

RegistryEntry.title: RegistryEntry
RegistryEntry.description: An entry in a state business registry with exactly the legal name.

id.description: The entity's number in that registry.

status.description: The status the registry gives (Active for the datasets of active entities only).

formed.description: The formation or registration date in that state.

formation_jurisdiction.description: Where the entity was formed, as the registry writes it.

source.description: The open-data URL for this entry.

MergerReview.title: MergerReview
MergerReview.description: FTC early termination notices under the HSR Act, searched by words of the legal name and kept when a party has exactly that name. Cached for 7 days per name.

read_at.description: When it was read. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

notices.description: Notices naming the company as a party, at most 20.

matched_in_search.description: How many notices the word search returned before names were compared.

date.description: The date early termination was granted.

role.description: The company's role in the notice.

date.description: When, as the source dates it; null when it gives no date.

kind.description: What it names. representative: a contact the site publishes in security.txt (a trooth:contact id); not a person authorized to act for the entity. signing_authority: the key that signed this reading's statement (a trooth:key id), named at signing. Since trooth 0.14.0: company: the company's Trooth record (a trooth:company id). product: a product named in the domain's signed declaration (trooth:product:<domain>/<id>); never inferred from a name match. person: the representative Trooth recorded at claim time (trooth:person:<16 hex>); no personal data in the id. signing_authority is also the company's own key (trooth:key:<domain>#<thumbprint>) from a declaration that checks. api from the declaration names the MCP manifest hash in basis. code_repository is marked repository_control when that proof is confirmed.

Entity.title: Entity
Entity.description: A legal entity, named by a Trooth id derived from its LEI or SEC CIK (docs/IDS.md).

id.description: trooth:entity:lei:<LEI> when the LEI binding is corroborated, otherwise trooth:entity:cik:<CIK>.

name.description: The legal name the registry holds.

Certificates.title: Certificates
Certificates.description: Certificates for the exact domain name in Certificate Transparency logs.

unexpired.description: How many unexpired certificates the monitor returned.

page_full.description: True when the monitor's first page was full, so there may be more.

expired.description: Whether Expires was in the past when read; null when it does not parse.

signed.description: Whether the file is OpenPGP clear-signed. The signature is not checked.

Sanctions.title: Sanctions
Sanctions.description: An exact-name check against a sanctions list.

list.description: The list and the part of it read.

read_at.description: When the list was read. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

matches.description: Entries with exactly one of those names (case, punctuation and suffix spellings folded). A name match is not an identification.

uid.description: The entry number on the list.

sha256.description: SHA-256 of the bytes read, hex.

complete.description: False when only the start of the document was read (a filing's first 256 KB).

fetched_at.description: When it was requested. An ISO 8601 date-time in UTC, as written by Trooth (for example 2026-10-06T20:00:44.820Z).

Signed.title: Signed
Signed.description: The statement naming the reading, and its log receipt.

record_sha256.description: SHA-256, hex, of the RFC 8785 bytes of the reading without `signed` (finite numbers in ECMAScript shortest form).

statement.description: The signed envelope; its payload is a public-record-statement.v1 document. Null when the reading could not be signed.

log.description: The receipt of the statement as a public_record entry of the witness statement log, or null when it was not logged.

problem.description: What could not be done (not signed, or signed and not logged), or null.

PublicFact.title: PublicFact
PublicFact.description: One fact as its source published it, with the URL it was read from.

key.description: A stable key, source.field (for example sec.tickers, lei.jurisdiction, dns.mta_sts).

value.description: The value as published: text, a number, true or false, a list of text, or null when the source states nothing.

source.description: Where it was read: a URL, or dns:<name> <type> for a DNS record.

BindingEvidence.title: BindingEvidence
BindingEvidence.description: One piece of evidence for or against a binding.

kind.description: For: filing_namespace_names_domain, registry_lists_domain, through_corroborated_filer (these tie the identifier to the domain), site_names_registry_name (a claim by the site), registries_agree, edgar_names_lei. Against: registry_lists_other_domain, registries_disagree, edgar_names_other_lei.

detail.description: What was seen, as a sentence.

source.description: Where it was seen, or null when it follows from other evidence.

EntityBinding.title: EntityBinding
EntityBinding.description: A link between the domain and a legal-entity identifier, with the evidence for and against it. Nothing is asserted beyond the evidence.

identifier.description: cik (SEC Central Index Key) or lei (Legal Entity Identifier).

value.description: The identifier: 10 digits for a CIK, 20 characters for an LEI.

id.description: The stable id: trooth:cik:<10 digits> or trooth:lei:<LEI> (docs/IDS.md).

found_by.description: How the identifier was found: asked (given by the requester), ticker, site_legal_name (the legal name the site states matched exactly one listed SEC filer), edgar_lei_field, registry_name_match (exact legal name and, when the SEC gives one, the jurisdiction).

status.description: corroborated: authoritative evidence ties it to the domain (the company's own filing or the registry record names the domain). claimed_by_site: the site names this entity, and nothing authoritative ties it. registries_only: registries agree with each other, nothing ties the domain. uncorroborated: no evidence either way. contradicted: authoritative evidence points elsewhere. not_found: the registry holds no such identifier.

proof_method.description: What ties the identifier to the domain, strongest first. regulator_filing: the company's 10-K XBRL namespace names the domain. registry_record: the LEI registry record lists the domain. site_statement: the site states the legal name; this is the site's claim. registry_name_match: a name match only; nothing ties the domain. asked: the caller supplied the identifier and nothing above ties it. none: no evidence ties it. Optional; added in trooth 0.13.0 (docs/EVIDENCE.md section 10). dns_txt: a TXT record in the domain's zone (Trooth's claim challenge at _trooth-challenge.<domain> with a value starting trooth-domain-challenge=, or the key pin trooth-key=<thumbprint> at _trooth-key.<domain>). domain_signed_declaration: a /.well-known/trooth.json that checks (docs/DECLARATION.md). identity_provider_sign_in: the publisher signed in through the company's identity provider at the domain (Google Workspace hosted domain or Microsoft Entra tenant), as Trooth recorded at claim time. domain_email_code: a code sent to a mailbox at the domain, as Trooth recorded at claim time. repository_control: the code host marks a domain of the organization as confirmed by the code host (GitHub is_verified). The five values after none were added in trooth 0.14.0.

Filing.title: Filing
Filing.description: One SEC filing, as EDGAR lists it.

report_date.description: The period or event date, when EDGAR gives one.

items.description: For an 8-K, the item numbers it reports (for example 1.05, 4.01).

description.description: EDGAR's description of the primary document.

FinancialFact.title: FinancialFact
FinancialFact.description: A value the company filed in XBRL, as it filed it: the latest annual (10-K, full fiscal year) value of the concept.

period_start.description: The period start for a flow such as revenue; null for a balance such as assets.

form.description: The form the value was filed in.

accession.description: The accession number of that filing.

source.description: The data.sec.gov URL the value was read from.

SiteRead.title: SiteRead
SiteRead.description: The legal names the company's pages state in copyright notices.

legal_names.description: Each legal name stated, with the page.

read.description: Whether any page of the site could be read.

reason.description: Why no name was found, or why the site was not read (for example its robots.txt opts out).

links.description: Pages the home page links to on the company's own domain: investor relations, trust center, security, status, sustainability. Linked, not read. Added in trooth 0.11.0.

SiteLink.title: SiteLink
SiteLink.description: A page the home page links to.

url.description: The link, without query or fragment.

SiteName.title: SiteName
SiteName.description: A legal name a page states.

SecRecord.title: SecRecord
SecRecord.description: The SEC filer's registration facts, filings and annual XBRL values.

facts.description: Registration facts on file with the SEC.

latest.description: The latest filing of each key form type, keyed by form.

events.description: 8-K filings of the last two years, newest first, at most 50.

events_cover_since.description: The earliest date the events cover.

cybersecurity_incidents.description: 8-K filings reporting Item 1.05, a material cybersecurity incident.

auditor_changes.description: 8-K filings reporting Item 4.01, a change of certifying accountant.

non_reliance.description: 8-K filings reporting Item 4.02, non-reliance on financial statements issued before.

insider_forms_last_90_days.description: Forms 3, 4 and 5 filed in the last 90 days.

direct_parent.description: The direct parent the record reports, or null.

ultimate_parent.description: The ultimate parent the record reports, or null.

EvidenceClass.title: EvidenceClass
EvidenceClass.description: One class of evidence in the reading, kept apart from the others, with its own freshness rule and a line saying what it does not establish.

class.description: The class of evidence. Default stale-after days: regulator_filing 90, registry_record 365, sanctions_list 7, procurement_exclusion 7, domain_registration 30, dns_configuration 2, certificate_transparency 7, site_publication 30, patent_record 90, merger_review 30. Since trooth 0.14.0: domain_declaration 30 (a key the site publishes shows who controlled the site's content when Trooth read it; it does not establish the legal entity or a person's authority to act for it), trooth_claim_record 365 (domain control at claim time; it does not establish that the person may act for the legal entity).

sections.description: The sections of this record that hold this class of evidence.

stale_after_days.description: After this many days from observed_at a reader should take the evidence as stale and read again.

does_not_establish.description: What this class of evidence does not show, in one sentence.

read.description: Whether this reading read any of the sections.

observed_at.description: When the evidence was observed: the reading's read_at, or the source's own earlier read time when a cached answer was used. Null when not read.

stale_after.description: observed_at plus stale_after_days, as an ISO 8601 time. Null when not read.

ContinuityEvent.title: ContinuityEvent
ContinuityEvent.description: One difference between this reading and the previous reading of the same domain.

kind.description: What differs. entity_changed: the domain now ties to a different legal entity. entity_appeared: it now ties to one and did not before. entity_disappeared: it tied to one and now ties to none. renamed: the same entity under a new name. parent_changed: the LEI record names a different direct or ultimate parent. registrar_changed: RDAP names a different registrar. domain_transferred: RDAP records a transfer after the previous reading. unchanged: none of these. Since trooth 0.14.0: declaration_appeared: a declaration that checks is published and the previous reading had none. declaration_key_changed: the declaration's keys differ from the previous reading's. declaration_disappeared: the previous reading had a declaration that checked and this one does not.

detail.description: The difference in words, naming both readings' values.

ContinuityPrevious.title: ContinuityPrevious
ContinuityPrevious.description: The previous cached reading of the same domain this reading was compared with.

read_at.description: When the previous reading was taken.

record_sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the previous record as it was cached.

Continuity.title: Continuity
Continuity.description: This reading compared with the previous cached reading of the same domain. A changed entity is never merged: the new reading carries only what it read now, and the event names both.

previous.description: The previous reading compared with; null when there is none.

events.description: What differs; empty when there is no previous reading, and a single unchanged event when nothing listed differs.

binds.description: The two subject ids the proof binds, the domain first.

proof_method.description: How the binding was shown (the same values as bindings[].proof_method).

status.description: confirmed: the proof holds as read. claimed: asserted, and nothing read confirms it. not_found: looked for and not there. not_read: the source could not be read (a 403 or 404 from a code host is not read, never absent).

source.description: The URL read, or "trooth record" for Trooth's own record of the claim.

observed_at.description: When the proof was observed: the reading's read_at, or for Trooth's record of the claim, when the claim was confirmed. Null when not read.

DeclarationReading.title: DeclarationReading
DeclarationReading.description: The domain-signed declaration as this reading found it.

status.description: checked: every rule in docs/DECLARATION.md holds. invalid: a rule fails (reason says which). expired: it checks but expires_at has passed. absent: the site answers 404 or 410. not_read: the site could not be read.

sha256.description: Lowercase hex SHA-256 of the bytes served; null when nothing was read.

keys.description: The kids of the keys it publishes (<domain>#<thumbprint>).

key_pinned_by_dns.description: Whether the TXT record at _trooth-key.<domain> names one of the keys.

products.description: The products it names, when it checks; empty otherwise.

apis.description: The APIs it names, when it checks; empty otherwise.

repositories.description: The repositories it names, when it checks; empty otherwise.
